files.home/.aws/cli/alias:
[toplevel]
whoami = sts get-caller-identity --query Account
ext = !echo hello
ext2 =
  !f() {
    echo "args: $@"
  }; f
extexit = !exit 3
dbg = sts get-caller-identity --debug
prof = sts get-caller-identity --profile foo
bad = sts "unterminated
badesc = sts \
nosuch = nosuchcmd foo
reg = --region eu-west-1 sts get-caller-identity
sts = sts --output text
chain = whoami
self = self
badquery = sts get-caller-identity --query "[["
Mixed = sts get-caller-identity
withopt = sts get-caller-identity --output yaml --color off
[command sts]
me = get-caller-identity --output text
get-caller-identity = get-caller-identity --output yaml
extsub = !echo sub
me2 = me --query Arn
subdbg = get-caller-identity --debug
loop = loop
loop2 = loop3
loop3 = loop2
[command s3]
myls = ls --summarize
ls = ls --human-readable
[command configure]
myget = get region
extc = !echo configure
[command ec2 wait]
fast = instance-running --instance-ids i-1
instance-stopped = instance-stopped --instance-ids i-2
